findings.title: Successful boost transfers can be rejected after late inclusion without automatic fulfillment or refund
findings.verification: Mocked parsed transaction with real verifyBoostPayment plus source review
findings.reproduction: An otherwise identical successful parsed SOL transfer plus correct memo is accepted when included 29 seconds after quote expiry, and rejected at 31 seconds with 'The payment was outside the quote window.'. The browser checks quote time before broadcast, but its SystemProgram transfer does not enforce that wall-clock deadline on-chain.
findings.impact: A transaction signed and submitted before expiry may land after the grace period while its blockhash remains valid. SOL has transferred, but confirm returns 409, no boost receipt is saved and the browser remains pending. No live loss was demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Make successful matching payments reconcilable: honor a bounded signed quote through its valid transaction lifetime, or record an explicit refundable/needs-review obligation. Do not silently discard an already-paid transaction.

findings.title: Changing a boost price in Admin breaks checkout for the changed package
findings.verification: Local-only integration of real admin pricing route, public quote route and frontend validator
findings.reproduction: The default 10x quote at USD 49.50 validates. Updating its admin price to 1234 cents succeeds; the new server quote is USD 12.34 at pricing revision 1. validateBoostQuote rejects it because it compares quote.usd with the static package default.
findings.impact: The price editor and displayed packages support dynamic pricing, but users cannot obtain a payable quote for any package whose price differs from its built-in default.
findings.recommendation: Validate against the reviewed dynamic price revision and exact quote, preserving amount/recipient checks and issued-quote consistency. Add an end-to-end test spanning admin price update and frontend quote validation.

findings.title: A signed boost payment that never lands can permanently block retry on that browser
findings.verification: Local-only recovery storage reproduction and source-confirmed confirm behavior
findings.reproduction: The client stores the signed identity before sendRawTransaction. If broadcast never lands, confirm returns pending for an absent transaction with no terminal expiry reconciliation. archiveBoostPayment accepts only matching finalized or failed receipts; a new quote/signature for that mint is rejected as already saved. Stored lastValidBlockHeight is not used to resolve this state.
findings.impact: A definitive preflight rejection or never-broadcast transaction can leave checkout verification-only indefinitely. New quote issuance also prunes old quotes after 48 hours, making an unresolved original confirm return 404. Recovery storage is scoped only to mint, so switching wallet does not avoid the stale record.
findings.recommendation: Journal pending payments server-side, retain unresolved quote records, and resolve never-landed attempts with verified finalized expiry and signature absence. Scope local records by network and payer. Never clear merely because one RPC lookup is missing.

findings.title: Keyboard focus escapes behind the open mobile navigation overlay
findings.verification: Reproduced in deployed browser at 390 by 844 viewport
findings.reproduction: Open menu, tab from Profile and wallet to Close navigation, then tab to Open menu and Search launches in main content. The sidebar still has class open while focus reaches Search launches behind it.
findings.impact: Keyboard and assistive-technology users can operate obscured page controls while the overlay remains open.
findings.recommendation: Make background content inert while the mobile menu is open and contain Tab/Shift+Tab focus, preserving Escape and focus restoration.

findings.title: Launch cards still promise X promotion while publishing is paused
findings.verification: Reconfirmed in live mobile launch funding step and marketing status
findings.reproduction: The package cards display 'Auto post & promote project to app X page.' and featured/launch post benefits. Their paused disclosure remains a title tooltip. The Marketing page explicitly says X publishing is paused pending account reinstatement.
findings.impact: Package selection overstates immediate service availability, particularly on touch devices. This was intentionally left outside the previous requested fix set.
findings.recommendation: Show the paused status and delivery conditions beside package benefits and price, before a user chooses a paid tier.
